replies.author: NotPineapple203
replies.body: Something that I tried to do was I tried to make it to where the iron in incorporated into the gameplay. You can parkour across the iron in ~5 seconds if you execute it properly. However it is quite difficult, and takes a skilled parkourist to get it right on the first try sprinting all the way through. I also varied the height the iron was in allowing for getting caught on blocks and critical hits to slow down those who couldn't execute the parkour. And another reason I laid down so much grass is to trouble those tunnelrats and force them to know where they are in the map because of the circles varying depressions.
